cd /tmp/obench-cell-k1d5d8e4/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_n9fz6iij && cat > /tmp/obench-cell-k1d5d8e4/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_n9fz6iij/_check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
d=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1]); o=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2]); img=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3]); H,W=img.shape[:2]
assert len(d)==len(o) and list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), (d.columns,o.columns)
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy(); bad=0
for i,r in o.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); pts=np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m)
    rect=len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4
    if n!=2 or rect or m.sum()==0: bad+=1; print('bad',i,n,rect)
    assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.xmax==xs.max() and r.ymin==ys.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
    cnt+=m; cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
    r0=d.iloc[i]; p0=np.stack([list(map(int,r0.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r0.coords_y.split(',')))],1).astype(np.int32)
    cv2.polylines(vis,[p0],True,(0,0,255) if r0.type=='rectangle' else (255,0,0),1)
print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'bad',bad)
cv2.imwrite('_vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
python _check.py demo_metadata.csv out/demo_metadata.csv demo_rgb.png
